run.prompt: Add a docstring to the slugify function in src/util.py.

tool_calls.input:
cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from src.util import slugify
print(repr(slugify('  Hello, World!  ')))
print(repr(slugify('Foo___bar--Baz')))
print(repr(slugify('---')))
assert slugify.__doc__ is not None, 'no docstring'
print('docstring present, first line:', slugify.__doc__.strip().splitlines()[0])
"
